# Version 2 license, then the option applies only if the new code is
# made subject to such option by the copyright holder.
#
# Contributor(s):

#
# resolve symlinks
#

PRG=$0

while [ -h "$PRG" ]; do
    ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
    link=`expr "$ls" : '^.*-> \(.*\)$' 2>/dev/null`
    if expr "$link" : '^/' 2> /dev/null >/dev/null; then
	PRG="$link"
    else
	PRG="`dirname "$PRG"`/$link"
    fi
done

progdir=`dirname "$PRG"`
APPNAME=`basename "$PRG"`

if [ -f "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

# XXX does not correctly deal with spaces in non-userdir params
args=""

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        userdir="${default_mac_userdir}"
        ;;
    *)
        userdir="${default_userdir}"
        ;;
esac
while [ $# -gt 0 ] ; do
    case "$1" in
        --userdir) shift; if [ $# -gt 0 ] ; then userdir="$1"; fi
            ;;
        *) args="$args "$1""
            ;;
    esac
    shift
done

if [ -f "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

if [ -n "$jdkhome" -a \! -d "$jdkhome" -a -d "$progdir/../$jdkhome" ]; then
    # #74333: permit jdkhome to be defined as relative to app dir
    jdkhome="$progdir/../$jdkhome"
fi

readClusters() {
  if [ -x /usr/ucb/echo ]; then
    echo=/usr/ucb/echo
  else
    echo=echo
  fi
  while read X; do
    if [ "$X" \!= "" ]; then
      $echo "$progdir/../$X"
    fi
  done
}

absolutize_paths() {
    while read path; do
        if [ -d "$path" ]; then
            (cd "$path" 2>/dev/null && pwd)
        else
            echo "$path"
        fi
    done
}

clusters=`(cat "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".clusters; echo) | readClusters | absolutize_paths | tr '
' ':'`

if [ ! -z "$extra_clusters" ] ; then
    clusters="$clusters:$extra_clusters"
fi

nbexec=`echo "$progdir"/../platform*/lib/nbexec`

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        eval exec sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            -J-Xdock:name='"$APPNAME"' \n            '"-J-Xdock:icon=$progdir/../../$APPNAME.icns"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
        ;;
    *)  
       sh=sh
       # #73162: Ubuntu uses the ancient Bourne shell, which does not implement trap well.
       if [ -x /bin/bash ]
       then
           sh=/bin/bash
       fi
       eval exec $sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
       exit 1
        ;;
esac

#!/bin/bash
cd /opt/unm2000/script
serverip=0.0.0.0 
installdir=/opt/unm2000
slaveip=0.0.0.0
lang=1
dbtype=1
deploymode=1
nodename=
while read line || [[ -n ${line} ]]
do
	if [[ $line =~ "CentrializedIP=" ]]
	then
		export serverip=${line##*CentrializedIP=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "UnmInstallPath=" ]]
	then
		export installdir=${line##*UnmInstallPath=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "DisSlaveIp=" ]]
	then
		export slaveip=${line##*DisSlaveIp=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "Language=" ]]
	then
		export lang=${line##*Language=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "dbtype=" ]]
	then
		export dbtype=${line##*dbtype=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "dbport=" ]]
	then
		export dbport=${line##*dbport=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "DeployMode=" ]]

		export deploymode=${line##*DeployMode=}
	fi

		export nodename=${line##*HostName=}
	fi

		export document=${line##*Document=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "NBIServer=" ]]
	then
		export nbiserver=${line##*NBIServer=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "SDNServer=" ]]
	then
		export sdnserver=${line##*SDNServer=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "ServerOption=" ]]
	then
		export serveroption=${line##*ServerOption=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "ClientOption=" ]]
	then
		export clientoption=${line##*ClientOption=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "architecture=" ]]
	then
		export architecture=${line##*architecture=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "hostNo=" ]]
	then
		export hostno=${line##*hostNo=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "isNBINode=" ]]
	then
		export isnbinode=${line##*isNBINode=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "dbIp=" ]]
	then
		export dbip=${line##*dbIp=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "poenable=" ]]
	then
		export poenable=${line##*poenable=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "pasCalcNum=" ]]
	then
		export pascalcnum=${line##*pasCalcNum=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "pasDbIp=" ]]
	then
		export pasdbip=${line##*pasDbIp=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "registryIp=" ]]
	then
		export registryip=${line##*registryIp=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "emsType=" ]]
	then
		export emstype=${line##*emsType=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "localIp=" ]]
	then
		export localip=${line##*localIp=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "abstractneserverNum=" ]]
	then
		export abstractneservernum=${line##*abstractneserverNum=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "UnmSingleinstall=" ]]
	then
		export unmsingleinstall=${line##*UnmSingleinstall=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "randompwd_flg=" ]]
	then
		export randompwd_flg=${line##*randompwd_flg=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "randompwd_str=" ]]
	then
		export randompwd_str=${line##*randompwd_str=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "ipv6=" ]]
	then
		export ipv6=${line##*ipv6=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "isIgniteMode=" ]]
	then
		export isignitemode=${line##*isIgniteMode=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "customerConfigXmlSourceFile=" ]]
	then
		export customerconfigxmlsourcefile=${line##*customerConfigXmlSourceFile=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "customerConfigXmlTargetFile=" ]]
	then
		export customerconfigxmltargetfile=${line##*customerConfigXmlTargetFile=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "pasDbMode=" ]]
	then
		export pasdbmode=${line##*pasDbMode=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "pasDbPort=" ]]
	then
		export pasdbport=${line##*pasDbPort=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "igniteServerAddr=" ]]
	then
		export igniteserveraddr=${line##*igniteServerAddr=}
	fi
done < $installdir/unm2000install.ini

# License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.

venv=${1:-pep8}
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}
export_upper_constratints_file

virtualenv sdist_check && sdist_check/bin/pip install pbr && sdist_check/bin/python setup.py sdist
sdistrc=$?
rm -rf sdist_check

tox -v -e$venv
rc=$?

[ -e .tox/$venv/bin/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
echo "======================================================================"
.tox/${venv}/bin/${freezecmd} freeze
echo "======================================================================"

if [ ! $sdistrc ] ; then
    echo "******************************************************************"
    echo "Project cannot create sdist tarball!!!"
    echo "To reproduce this locally, run: 'python setup.py sdist'"
    echo "******************************************************************"
    exit $sdistrc
fi

exit $rc

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=`dirname $0`
SERVICE=nmtool_cm_agent
cmagentPath=$UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent
systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null    
if [ $? -eq 0 ]
then
	echo "${SERVICE}is runing, please check and stop it before install"
	exit 0
fi

ROOT_DIR=`pwd`
data=`gcc -v 2>&1`
if [[ $data =~ "gcc version" ]]||[[ $data =~ "gcc 版本" ]]
then
  echo 安装了gcc
else 
  echo 没有安装gcc,自动安装gcc
  #rpm -Uvh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/tools/gcc/*.rpm --nodeps --force 
fi
#source ${UNM_ROOT}/server/tool/unmvars.sh
$UNM_ROOT/server/tool/Python27/python -m pip install --no-index --find-links=$UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/packages -r $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/requirements-linux.txt

#unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH
#chmod 777 cmagentstart.server
#chmod 777 nmtool_cm_agent.service

startType="0"
if [ ! -f $UNM_ROOT/unm2000install.ini ];
then
	echo not exit unm2000install.ini file
else
    startType=$(cat $UNM_ROOT/unm2000install.ini | grep startType | awk -F '=' '{print $2}')
fi
if [[ $startType -eq "1" ]]
then
        sudo chmod u+r $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent.service
		sudo cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/cmagentstart.server /etc/init.d/
		sudo cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent-user.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/nmtool_cm_agent.service
	
        sudo systemctl enable nmtool_cm_agent
        sudo systemctl daemon-reload
		if [ ! -d $cmagentPath/temp ];then
			mkdir $cmagentPath/temp
		fi
else
		chmod u+r $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent.service
		cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/cmagentstart.server /etc/init.d/
		cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/nmtool_cm_agent.service
		systemctl enable $SERVICE
        systemctl daemon-reload
fi

#!/bin/bash
source /etc/profile
cd /etc/init.d

chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmstop.server
chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmtoolstop.server
# chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server
chmod 777 $UNM_ROOT/script/killAllProcess.sh

if [ -d "/usr/local/nginx" ];then
rm -r /user/local/nginx
fi

chkconfig --del unmstart.server

chkconfig --del unmtoolstart.server

chkconfig --del passtart.server

#Í£Ö¹·þÎñ

/etc/init.d/unmstop.server
/etc/init.d/unmtoolstop.server
# /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server stop
/etc/init.d/unmactivemq.server stop
/etc/init.d/unmtao.server stop


$UNM_ROOT/script/killAllProcess.sh

#È¡Ïû¿ª»ú×ÔÆô¶¯
chkconfig -d unmactivemq.server
chkconfig -d unmtao.server
result=$(cat /etc/SuSE-release | grep "VERSION = 12" )
if [[ "$result" != "" ]] ;then
     version="12"
else
     version="11"
fi
if [[ "$version" = "12" ]] ;then
    systemctl disable unm2000.service
    systemctl disable unmtool.service 
    # systemctl disable tomcat.service
else
    chkconfig -del unmstart.server
    chkconfig -del unmtoolstart.server
    # chkconfig -del tomcat.service
fi

#cusaÐ¶ÔØ±ß³µ
revisionfile=$UNM_ROOT/server/etc/revision.txt
grep "iscusa=true" $revisionfile>>/dev/nul
if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
	sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/sidecar/bin/uninstall_sidecar_service.sh
fi

# Ð¶ÔØ¹ÜÀí¹¤¾ß
sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/scripts/uninstall_nmtool.sh

#Ð¶ÔØnginx
sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nginx/script_linux/uninstall_service.sh

if [[ $deploymode -eq 1 || $deploymode -eq 2 ]];then
chmod 777 $UNM_ROOT/jetty/uninstalljetty.sh
#Ð¶ÔØjetty
sh $UNM_ROOT/jetty/uninstalljetty.sh
fi

cd $UNM_ROOT/script
# rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unm.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmstart.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmstop.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtool.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtoolstart.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtoolstop.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmactivemq.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtao.server
